Example Broker Documentation

Name

example-broker.conf — the configuration file for the example broker

Synopsis

example-broker.conf

Description

The broker reads this file at start-up. Each line holds one option and its value.

General Options

listener port

Listen for incoming network connections on the given port.

log_dest destination

Send log messages to a particular destination.

Examples

listener 1883
log_dest stdout

Bridges

A bridge connects two brokers.

Examples

connection bridge-01
address 192.0.2.10:1883

See Also
